verses.1: Therefore, I ask you, brothers, to show through your sacrifices that your bodies are offered as a holy and pleasing offering to God. This is the true form of worship that we should practice.
verses.2: And do not become trapped in this worldly life; rather, transform your minds through renewal, so that you may be able to determine what God’s will is—what is good, pleasing, and perfect.
verses.3: I say that, because of the grace with which everything has been given to me, I should not be too cautious in what it is necessary to do. Instead, I should act with wisdom, just as God has measured faith for each person.
verses.4: For just as we have many parts in one body, so too, none of these parts can function independently.
verses.5: In this way, many will be united in Christ; but each person will still remain separate from others.
verses.6: Having received various gifts according to the will of God, whether they were prophecies based on the proportion of faith.
verses.7: Whether in teaching, or whether the teacher is in the classroom.
verses.8: Whether the one who asks is humble in his request, or the one who passes on information in a simple manner, or the one who acts with respect, or the one who is kind and gentle.
verses.9: Love is unconditionally true. Leaving behind the evil person, clinging to the good one.
verses.10: Those who are fond of each other, who respect each other, and who put one another before everything else.
verses.11: Not being afraid of death, living with the spirit, serving the Lord.
verses.12: joying in hope, suffering in sorrow, and praying with devotion.
verses.13: By sharing in the hardships of the saints, they sought to practice hospitality.
verses.14: Praise those who persecute you; also, do not be harmed by them.
verses.15: To be happy with those who are happy, and to cry with those who cry.
verses.16: They should care for each other, not those who are too proud. They should be humble and willing to help others. Do not be too proud of yourselves.
verses.17: We do not give anything good in place of evil. We strive to be good in the eyes of all people.
verses.18: If possible, that is, with the approval of all people.
verses.19: “Do not punish yourselves, beloved, but rather give place to your anger. For it is written: ‘I will take revenge for myself.’” said the Lord.
verses.20: But if your enemy suffers pain, then crush him. If he cries out in pain, then kill him. This is how you can prevent the charcoal of fire from being poured onto his head.
verses.21: I will not be defeated by the evil; instead, I will win in the midst of evil.
